description: Sub-GHz, infrared and NFC tool for the CardputerZero and Cap CC1101

store.summary: Sub-GHz, infrared and NFC tool for the Cap CC1101, Flipper file compatible
store.description:
ZeroSub turns the CardputerZero and the M5Stack Cap CC1101 into a pocket radio tool.

Sub-GHz (CC1101): frequency analyzer, signal meter, Read and Read RAW captures on the 17 Flipper Zero default channels with AM270/AM650/FM238/FM476 presets, a saved-signal library, manual key entry, and Send limited to the EU licence-free bands.

Infrared: learn remotes from the built-in receiver, save them and send them again.

NFC (ST25R3916): read NTAG and MIFARE Ultralight tags in full, read the UID of other NFC-A cards, write saved tags to blank ones and emulate them to a reader. NFC support is new and still being tested on hardware.

Signals, remotes and tags are stored as Flipper Zero .sub, .ir and .nfc files, so they can be copied between ZeroSub and a Flipper in either direction. Requires the M5Stack Cap CC1101.
